sources: James Palm — Veo3 Camera Movements Reference (Medium, 2026)
Google Cloud — Ultimate Prompting Guide for Veo 3.1 (cloud.google.com/blog)
_meta.principle: Start static, add ONE movement per scene, reserve compound movements for maximum-impact moments. Veo / Kling / Seedance all read this vocabulary.
_meta.interpolation_rule: Always include a stability cue (smooth, slow, locked, gimbal) and a single-axis direction (in / out / left / right / up / down). Avoid stacking conflicting motion verbs in one prompt.

static._use_when: You want the viewer's eye on the subject, not the camera. Best for product hero, talking head, locked-camera reveals (e.g., LED light-up sequence).

eye_level_static.name: Eye Level Static
eye_level_static.use: Neutral observation, conversations, product on desk
eye_level_static.fragment: Static eye-level shot of [SUBJECT], centered in frame, locked camera no movement

low_angle_power.name: Low Angle Power
low_angle_power.use: Hero moments, authority, making product feel monumental
low_angle_power.fragment: Low-angle static shot looking up at [SUBJECT], dramatic perspective, locked camera

high_angle_vulnerability.name: High Angle Vulnerability
high_angle_vulnerability.use: Defeat, isolation, problem-state in a Hook→Problem ad pattern
high_angle_vulnerability.fragment: High-angle static shot looking down at [SUBJECT] from above, locked camera

dutch_angle.name: Dutch Angle
dutch_angle.fragment: 15-degree dutch angle tilt static shot of [SUBJECT], locked camera

extreme_close_up.name: Extreme Close Up
extreme_close_up.use: Emotion, product detail reveal (LED row, etched logo, texture)
extreme_close_up.fragment: Extreme close-up of [SUBJECT DETAIL], macro-level detail visible, locked camera

wide_establishing.name: Wide Establishing
wide_establishing.use: Environmental context — first frame of a scene change
wide_establishing.fragment: Wide static establishing shot of [LOCATION], [LIGHTING], locked camera

over_the_shoulder.name: Over The Shoulder
over_the_shoulder.fragment: Over-the-shoulder static shot from behind [CHARACTER A] looking at [SUBJECT B], locked camera

birds_eye.name: Birds Eye
birds_eye.use: Patterns, geometry, top-down product flat lay
birds_eye.fragment: Directly overhead bird's eye view looking straight down at [SUBJECT], locked camera

worms_eye.name: Worms Eye
worms_eye.use: Towering perspective — hero shots of vertical objects
worms_eye.fragment: Extreme low worm's eye view from ground level looking up at [SUBJECT], locked camera

symmetrical_center.name: Symmetrical Center
symmetrical_center.use: Balanced composition, Wes Anderson-adjacent, premium brand vibe
symmetrical_center.fragment: Perfectly symmetrical center-framed static shot of [SUBJECT], Wes Anderson style symmetry, locked camera

linear._use_when: You need to create momentum, reveal, or build tension. ONE direction at a time.

slow_push_in.name: Slow Push In
slow_push_in.use: Building tension before reveal, drawing focus to a hero element
slow_push_in.fragment: Slow cinematic push-in toward [SUBJECT], building tension, smooth steadicam motion

pull_out_reveal.name: Pull Out Reveal
pull_out_reveal.use: Showing broader context, going from intimate detail to scale
pull_out_reveal.fragment: Slow pull-out dolly shot starting on close-up of [SUBJECT], gradually revealing [WIDER CONTEXT]

lateral_track_lr.name: Lateral Track Lr
lateral_track_lr.fragment: Smooth lateral tracking shot moving left to right following [SUBJECT], gimbal stable

lateral_track_rl.name: Lateral Track Rl
lateral_track_rl.fragment: Smooth tracking shot moving right to left past [ENVIRONMENT], gimbal stable

crane_up.name: Crane Up
crane_up.use: Ascending aerial reveal — epic scale, end-of-scene reveal
crane_up.fragment: Smooth crane shot rising from ground level upward, revealing [SCENE]

crane_down.name: Crane Down
crane_down.use: Descending to subject — focus-pull from sky to person/product
crane_down.fragment: Descending crane shot from elevated position down to ground level focusing on [SUBJECT]

dolly_zoom.name: Dolly Zoom
dolly_zoom.use: Disorienting psychological effect — Hitchcock vertigo, panic moments
dolly_zoom.fragment: Dolly zoom effect on [SUBJECT], Hitchcock vertigo effect, background warps while subject stays same size
dolly_zoom.warning: Hard for AI models. Test on Veo Lite first before committing budget.

crash_zoom_in.name: Crash Zoom In
crash_zoom_in.use: Sudden dramatic impact — punchline beat, hook punctuation
crash_zoom_in.fragment: Rapid crash zoom from wide shot to extreme close-up of [SUBJECT], jarring fast motion

whip_pan_right.name: Whip Pan Right
whip_pan_right.use: Dynamic transition between shots, energy injection
whip_pan_right.fragment: Fast whip pan to the right creating motion blur, dynamic transition

whip_pan_left.name: Whip Pan Left
whip_pan_left.fragment: Fast whip pan to the left with motion blur, dynamic energy

tilt_up.name: Tilt Up
tilt_up.use: Revealing feet-to-face, tall structure reveal, character introduction
tilt_up.fragment: Slow vertical tilt from ground level up to [TOP OF SUBJECT], smooth motion

tilt_down.name: Tilt Down
tilt_down.use: Settling on subject from above, descent to detail
tilt_down.fragment: Vertical tilt from sky/high position slowly down to ground level focusing on [SUBJECT]

orbital._use_when: Hero product shots, character introductions, when you need to show all sides of something. Premium/cinematic feel.

180_orbit.name: 180 Orbit
180_orbit.fragment: Smooth 180-degree orbit rotating around [SUBJECT], slow continuous motion

360_orbit.name: 360 Orbit
360_orbit.use: Full hero shot — product from every angle in one continuous shot
360_orbit.fragment: Complete 360-degree orbit around [SUBJECT], slow continuous rotation, gimbal smooth

low_orbit.name: Low Orbit
low_orbit.fragment: Low-angle orbital shot circling [SUBJECT] at ground level

ascending_spiral.name: Ascending Spiral
ascending_spiral.use: Epic rising reveal — outro shot for premium brand moments
ascending_spiral.fragment: Ascending spiral rising while orbiting [SUBJECT], starting low and ending bird's eye

descending_spiral.name: Descending Spiral
descending_spiral.use: Aerial-to-ground transition, intro shot from sky to subject
descending_spiral.fragment: Descending spiral shot orbiting [SUBJECT] while lowering from height to ground

half_orbit_push_in.name: Half Orbit Push In
half_orbit_push_in.use: Compound hero moment — combines reveal + focus
half_orbit_push_in.fragment: 90-degree orbit combined with slow push-in toward [SUBJECT], building emphasis

orbit_crane_up.name: Orbit Crane Up
orbit_crane_up.fragment: Begin orbiting [SUBJECT] at ground level while craning upward, revealing scale

figure_8.name: Figure 8
figure_8.use: Connecting multiple subjects in one shot
figure_8.fragment: Figure-8 camera path weaving between [SUBJECT A] and [SUBJECT B]
figure_8.warning: Complex motion — likely to drift. Use for short clips only.

through_frame.name: Through Frame
through_frame.use: Layered cinematic discovery — start through a doorway/window
through_frame.fragment: Camera moves through natural frame element ([DOORWAY/WINDOW/ARCH]) toward [SUBJECT]

follow_behind.name: Follow Behind
follow_behind.use: Immersive walking perspective — hero walking away or toward destination
follow_behind.fragment: Camera follows directly behind [SUBJECT] at walking pace, locked tracking shot

specialty._use_when: When you want a specific aesthetic signature (UGC, documentary, slo-mo product)

handheld_documentary.name: Handheld Documentary
handheld_documentary.use: Authentic organic feel — UGC-style ad opening, native to social feeds
handheld_documentary.fragment: Handheld-style shot following [SUBJECT], camera gently swaying, slight natural motion

first_person_pov.name: First Person Pov
first_person_pov.use: Immersive vlog energy, user-perspective product use
first_person_pov.fragment: First-person POV shot from [SUBJECT'S] perspective, eye level, looking at [TARGET]

rack_focus.name: Rack Focus
rack_focus.use: Depth revelation — shifting attention from foreground to background
rack_focus.fragment: Rack focus shot shifting from sharp foreground ([FG SUBJECT]) to sharp background ([BG SUBJECT])

slow_motion.name: Slow Motion
slow_motion.use: Dramatic detail emphasis — magnetic snap moment, water droplet, fabric movement
slow_motion.fragment: Ultra slow motion capture of [ACTION], cinematic high-frame-rate look, time stretched

time_lapse.name: Time Lapse
time_lapse.use: Compressed temporal change — sunrise, building progress, charging fill
time_lapse.fragment: Accelerated time-lapse style movement of [SCENE], compressed time

underwater_pov.name: Underwater Pov
underwater_pov.fragment: Underwater camera perspective looking up, light rays filtering through surface

macro_extreme_detail.name: Macro Extreme Detail
macro_extreme_detail.use: Scientific beauty — extreme product detail (texture, finish, etched mark)
macro_extreme_detail.fragment: Macro lens extreme close-up revealing microscopic detail of [SUBJECT TEXTURE]

split_diopter.name: Split Diopter
split_diopter.use: Dual-plane focus — foreground product + background user both sharp
split_diopter.fragment: Split diopter lens effect with sharp focus on foreground ([FG]) and background ([BG]) simultaneously
split_diopter.warning: Rarely renders correctly on AI models. Use sparingly.
